authority.configuration: exact frozen EgressConfiguration; externally authenticated hosts, ports, synthetic initiating origins, DNS-over-TLS endpoint and certificate roots
authority.hosts: lowercase canonical ASCII DNS labels, no literal IP, trailing dot, credentials or hepta.invalid destination namespace; exact approved hostname and port
authority.origin: exact port-free HTTPS tuple: https://shell.system.hepta.invalid or https://<app_id>.<publisher>.apps.hepta.invalid; no slash, query, fragment or custom scheme
authority.session: exact owner-bound SessionBinding object, bounded session_id, positive generation and approved initiating_origin
authority.permit: single-use actual issuer-retained ObservationPermit object; immutable operation_id, canonical initial URL, exact host and redirect scope, actual session object and current owner epoch
authority.revocation: bind_session or close invalidates pending and active permissions; active I/O rechecks before each bounded step
authority.process: client authority belongs to its creating PID; inherited fork objects are refused before any mutex or socket, including final active-record cleanup; threads in the creator process may cancel and revoke
authority.clock: one monotonic deadline per operation; a backward or nonfinite monotonic clock permanently revokes this client owner

resolver.protocol: DNS-over-TLS over one exact approved numeric TCP endpoint with explicit CA roots, hostname verification and exact peer check before and after TLS
resolver.fresh_resolution: every HTTPS hop; no DNS cache, libc resolver, ambient proxy or caller socket
resolver.address_selection: sort unique answers by IP version then packed bytes; one connection to first answer after all A/AAAA answers pass policy

address_policy.ipv4: global unicast only; additionally reject explicit special-use ranges including loopback, private, CGNAT, link-local/metadata, documentation, benchmarking, multicast and reserved
address_policy.ipv6: global unicast within 2000::/3 only; additionally reject mapped IPv4, 2001::/23, 2001:db8::/32, 2002::/16, 3fff::/20, scoped, private, link-local/metadata and multicast

https.certificate: CERT_REQUIRED plus DNS hostname verification using only explicit caller-approved immutable CA PEM bytes
https.peer: actual getpeername IP equals the admitted DNS answer and port equals the exact approved port; IPv6 scope id must be zero
https.alpn: http/1.1 or absent; HTTP/2 and other protocols refused
https.response: HTTP/1.1 status 200 only; unique ASCII nonfolded headers; exact bounded Content-Length; identity encoding; immutable complete body bytes
https.charset: absent, UTF-8 or US-ASCII; returned bytes are never rendered, executed or loaded by this client
https.redirect: each Location is parsed as strict HTTPS and each hop rechecks session, owner, origin, permit scope, configured host, fresh DNS, all answers, exact socket peer and TLS certificate; repeated URL and hop limit refused

outcome.response: immutable operation_id, complete body SHA256, bounded headers and per-hop connection receipts
outcome.policy_digest: SHA256 of ASCII canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=true of approved host-port pairs, origins, HTTPS CA digest, resolver address-port-TLS-name-CA digest and qualification addresses or null

policy_object_fields.ca_sha256: SHA256 of exact HTTPS CA PEM bytes or null
policy_object_fields.resolver: object with exactly address,port,tls_hostname,ca_sha256 (SHA256 of exact resolver CA PEM bytes), or null
policy_object_fields.qualification_addresses: sorted exact loopback strings or null

outcome.before_http_send: policy/protocol/cancellation/deadline refusal; protected exact-permit reservation precedes consumption and active insertion; completed cleanup after a reserved admission interruption gives chained EgressDenied with the permit consumed and no invented connection identity; an unreserved competing caller cannot retire the winner
outcome.after_http_send_attempt: EgressIndeterminate on failure within managed I/O and cleanup including KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit; preserves operation_id, attempted connection, completed hops recorded before TLS close and cause; permit stays consumed
outcome.cleanup: shared private reservation in retained creator-PID/thread mutex lease, constructed before consumption and covering admission/helper return; each admission/final acquisition waits at most 0.05 seconds; only matching owned permit records retire; ownership retires before actual release, never releases a future holder; unconfirmed final cleanup permanently quarantines this client before subsequent authority mutexes and retains at most four active records; before HTTP send returns chained EgressDenied without invented connection facts; no repair or replay API
outcome.interruption_evidence_scope: specific Python call/line/helper-return boundaries, actual socket close and native mutex release/reacquisition/GC/fork; no proof of all C-call-to-attribute-storage opcode windows or caller receipt of the API final return

qualification.profile: explicit exact QualificationProfile accepted only by QualificationEgressClient; rejected by production ControlledEgress
qualification.socket_tls_code: same resolver, TLS, peer, redirect, deadline and body path as production; exact loopback address policy is the sole network allowance
qualification.keys: temporary test-only OpenSSL CA/server fixtures; no production keys or roots

remaining_installed_obligations: authenticated policy, host approval UI, root lifecycle and trusted session provisioning
privileged browser network namespace without ambient raw socket or proxy authority
integration and causal interception of every browser resource class and external navigation
synthetic origin interception with no public DNS or external fallback
external effect admission and durable indeterminate reconciliation without replay
installed resolver, TLS clock, certificate revocation and platform/hardware qualification
